title: HB 883 (2012 Regular Session): Voter identification; require, but allow electors to cast ballot and be counted, if elector signs a sworn statement.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1(1)
(quote) Each person who shall appear to vote in person at a polling place or the registrar's office shall be required to identify himself or herself to an election manager or the registrar by presenting current and valid photo identification before such person shall be allowed to vote.
(section) Sec. 1(2)
(quote) The identification required by subsection (1) of this section shall include, but not be limited to, the following: (a) A current and valid Mississippi driver's license; (b) A current and valid identification card issued by a branch, department, agency or entity of the State of Mississippi; (c) A current and valid United States passport;
(section) Sec. 1(2)
(quote) (f) A valid tribal identification card containing a photograph of the elector; (g) A current and valid United States military identification card; and (h) An official Mississippi voter identification card containing a photograph of the elector.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 1(3)
(quote) A person who appears to vote in person at a polling place and does not have identification as required by this section may vote by ballot and the ballot shall then be counted if the person signs a form that allows the person to swear and affirm under penalty of perjury that such person is the elector listed on the ballot.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Conforming 23-15-631(3)
(quote) The Secretary of State shall prepare instructions on how absent voters may comply with the identification requirements of Section 1 of House Bill No.____, 2012 Regular Session.
(section) Conforming 23-15-719
(quote) The registrar shall identify the applicant by requiring him to present identification as required by Section 1 of House Bill No.____, 2012 Regular Session, and shall then deliver the ballots to the applicant by mail or to the applicant in the registrar's office.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1(5)
(quote) The intentional failure of an election official to require a voter to present identification as required by this section shall be considered corrupt conduct under Section 97-13-19 and shall be reported to the Secretary of State and the Attorney General.
(section) Sec. 2(5)
(quote) The registrar shall require presentation and verification of the following information during the application process before issuance of a Mississippi Voter Identification Card: (a) A photo identity document;
(other) Sec. 1(4): intimidating a voter by using the section is punished by fine of at least $5,000 and/or 1-5 years
(other) Sec. 2: Mississippi Voter Identification Card applications taken at registrar offices; not available to holders of a valid driver license or state ID
(other) Conforming: 23-15-135, 23-15-11, 23-15-541, 23-15-631, 23-15-639, 23-15-719
(other) Preclearance
